text:
Type: full-length tilting standing mirror
Use: checking an outfit, reflecting light; bedroom, hallway, dressing area
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: white painted solid wood frame and stand, mirror glass
Colors: white, silver mirror
Shape: tall narrow rectangular mirror pivoting between two angled legs, A-frame easel stand, small slatted shelf near the floor, light and open
Feel: fresh, airy, practical, gentle
Goes with: white or light wood furniture, pastel textiles, wooden floors; Scandinavian, farmhouse or cottage bedrooms

product.name: ISFJORDEN
product.description: Provided with safety film - reduces damage if glass is broken.
